items.title: Exercise special termination right to reject price increase
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The letter grants a special right to terminate the contract without notice effective 01.01.2027 if the customer objects to the price change. 'Dieser Tag' refers to the effective date of the price change, 01.01.2027. The termination notice must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag', i.e. strictly before 01.01.2027. The last day it can arrive is therefore 31.12.2026, which is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed.
